lead: The Long Island mansion in Taylor's 2014 'Blank Space' video has reportedly sold for a whopping $72 million. Oheka Castle is reportedly one of the largest private homes in the U.S. and was once owned by financier Otto Kahn. It's now run as a hotel and event venue and reportedly owed $64 million to creditors when its owner filed for bankruptcy last year. According to Grazia, a winning bid of $72 million was placed for the castle at auction on October 27, 2026. It's not yet clear who bought the property, but the buyers reportedly plan to "preserve the castle." The transaction must still be approved by a bankruptcy court.

sentences.text: Oheka Castle, the Long Island estate where Taylor filmed the 2014 'Blank Space' video, reportedly drew a winning bid of $72 million at auction on October 27, 2026.
The sale follows a Chapter 11 bankruptcy filing by the entity tied to longtime owner Gary Melius and a subsequent foreclosure auction; the property reportedly owed $64 million to creditors.
Ronald Browning and Paul Alflen of Gold Coast Property & Estate Management reportedly placed the winning bid and say they plan to "preserve the castle."
The transaction must be confirmed by the federal bankruptcy court, with a hearing scheduled for a Thursday following the auction.
The buyer will have to honor all events on the calendar through at least March 31, 2028, since the property currently functions as a luxury hotel and wedding venue.
Built between 1914 and 1919 for financier Otto Hermann Kahn, the castle contains roughly 127 rooms.

lead: Taylor was caught on a hot mic saying she wasn't a Knicks fan, and the remark sparked backlash online. ESPN analyst Monica McNutt has explained how it happened - and why she's still baffled by its viral reception.

sentences.text: Taylor Swift was seen at Game 4 of the 2026 NBA Finals between the New York Knicks and San Antonio Spurs on Thursday. However, she drew the ire of some of her fans after ESPN sports analyst Monica McNutt was caught on a hot mic saying Taylor was not a Knicks fan and told her to 'get out of there'.

The video of McNutt's remarks went viral online and she apologized after the backlash. But the 44-year-old journalist admitted that she is still 'mystified' as to how the hot mic remark was shared publicly.

Speaking to her own podcast The Pivot, McNutt said: "I learned about it after the game. I'm still mystified about how this video made its way into the public. I didn't anticipate my remark to be so important to anyone outside the broadcast." She added: "I don't want it blown out of proportion. It was a throwaway colloquialism. I wasn't taking it literally in the slightest." McNutt also told the podcast that she had been "a little blindsided by the whole thing."

Taylor has been spotted at Knicks games multiple times in recent seasons, and she sported a 'Stevie Knicks' t-shirt when she watched the team play in the NBA Finals in June 2025. But fans remain divided over whether Taylor is truly a Knicks fan, as she attended a game in Dallas last year wearing a Mavericks t-shirt, and some speculate that she only attends games for Travis Kelce's benefit.

lead: In 2006 Taylor Swift was a teenager singing opening sets for Rascal Flatts and George Strait. Now she’s one of the biggest artists on the planet. For the 20th anniversary of her debut album, Variety has published an early interview that details Taylor’s life and creative process during that era.

sentences.text: When her namesake LP hit stores on October 24, 2006, Taylor Swift was just 16 years old and signed with Big Machine Label Group.
Her songwriting talent was already well-demonstrated, though; Taylor wrote or co-wrote all 11 tracks on the album.

Five singles were released from the project (including the smash hits “Our Song” and “Should’ve Said No,” which made her the first female artist to score back-to-back No. 1 songs on Billboard’s Hot Country Songs chart), and Taylor spent two years on the road opening for acts like Rascal Flatts and George Strait.
It spent 24 non-consecutive weeks at the top of the Top Country Albums chart and sold over 7 million copies.

In an early-period interview published today as part of a 20th anniversary retrospective, Taylor talks about her creative process on the album, why she chose a self-titled project as her debut and why she wrote songs about boys she never dated.
Unfortunately there doesn’t appear to be a deluxe version of the album coming out to mark the anniversary.

lead: Her self-titled debut album was released 20 years ago today, and Taylor just bought back the rights to the original master recordings. Read all about it here!

sentences.text: The debut album was released on October 24, 2006 by Big Machine Records and reached the number 19 position on the Billboard Hot 100, earning platinum status.
Two hits came from the album, “Tim McGraw” and “Our Song,” as well as producer Nathan Chapman and co-writer Liz Rose helping the then teenaged Taylor develop her songwriting skills.
In May 2025, Taylor announced she had bought the master recordings of her first six albums from Shamrock Capital.
A re-recording of the debut album is now complete, though no release date has been announced.
On the album’s 20th birthday, Variety published a nearly complete Q&A from an interview with 18-year-old Taylor back in January 2008.
At the time, she was still riding the tail end of “Our Song,” the first song she wrote by herself and still one of her favorite tracks.
A few weeks later, Taylor was named People’s Sexiest Woman Alive, and she also reflected on the album’s impact.
On the 20th anniversary of Taylor’s self-titled debut, released October 24, 2006, XL Country 100.7 published a retrospective on how the record shaped country music.

Variety’s Chris Willman built the piece on a previously unpublished early-period Q&A with Taylor, recapping five back-to-back singles, a long run atop the country albums chart, and opening slots that built her early profile.
Taylor’s self-titled debut album turns 20 today, and Vanity Fair revisits how it came together.
The piece frames it as the start of a career built on turning ordinary, often painful experiences into songs.
Fans care because it retraces the early Nashville-era decisions, including the RCA deal she walked away from and her signing with Scott Borchetta’s Big Machine label.

Official photos from the ceremony are still pending.
The Duke of Cambridge appeared on The Graham Norton Show on Friday, October 23, 2026.
Kelce told reporters at Kansas City Chiefs training camp the wedding was “the best night of my life.”

lead: The Prince of Wales said he was “trying to” edit Travis Kelce out of the June 2024 photo with Taylor Swift.

sentences.text: On Tuesday night’s episode of The Graham Norton Show, Prince William opened up about a famous photo he took with Swift.
“It was June 2024 and Travis kept coming back in,” he joked. “I kept trying to edit him out and I can’t get him out of this picture. I can’t get him out.”
The photo in question was taken during Taylor’s Eras Tour and was used in an Instagram post in which she confirmed she was dating Kelce.
“I didn’t appreciate how much that photo meant to the whole world until recently,” William admitted.
One report has linked the photo to Taylor’s Wembley Stadium performance in London.

Taylor’s other royal moment came at the 2013 Kensington Palace gala for the Centrepoint charity when the then 21-year-old joined Prince William and Bon Jovi’s Jon Bon Jovi for a rendition of “Livin’ On A Prayer.”
Kelce said meeting the British royals was “such a delight.”

lead: Taylor’s debut album turns 20 this week — and her official site has a special section for it.

sentences.text: Taylor Swift’s official website has a new “20 Years of Taylor Swift” archive section dedicated to the singer’s self-titled debut album, which was released on October 24, 2006.
Swifties spotted it on Oct. 23.
The section has streaming links to tracks from the album, photos from Taylor’s early career, highlights from her discography and early videos.
In a letter released last month, Taylor addressed buying back her first six masters and said she had already “completely re-recorded” her self-titled album.
However, a ‘Taylor’s Version’ of the record hasn’t been officially announced.
While Taylor didn’t post on social media on the anniversary, the Taylor Nation account shared a video on Instagram featuring clips of Taylor across her career.
The 11-second clip ends with the words “20 years of Taylor Swift.”

lead: Taylor Swift met Tim McGraw at a 2007 awards show when she was 16 years old. He lost an award that night. She lost one too.

sentences.text: In October 2007, Taylor attended the ACM Awards in Nashville. She was 16 years old.
The night before the ceremony, she recorded "Love Story." It was released the day after she lost an award there.
In the same room, Tim McGraw lost the Entertainer of the Year award to Kenny Chesney.
Taylor lost Top New Female Vocalist of the Year to Miranda Lambert.
Her album, Speak Now, is in the running for that same award tonight.
McGraw met Taylor the next day.

According to the star, "I walked up to Taylor at the ACM Awards after the show, and I asked for her number and she gave it to me. And then my wife came in and she went to leave the number, and I said no. Don't write that number down because it will never come up on my phone. It will only be a number that I can't remember, but I'll never forget." "I don't know what kind of song she wrote about me, but that was a big moment for me." Taylor, of course, sang "Tim McGraw."

"It's a funny story, that the day I first met Tim McGraw, I wasn't winning, he wasn't winning, and I was scared and shy," said the 20-year-old, "and we all became winners, somehow, and that's what I want to thank all the Academy Country Music Awards for, because we all have grown up together, and we've all had to learn from each other."

Stereogum writer Tom Breihan says: "I believe her on-camera story of the two of them meeting. I've watched her talk about McGraw for years, and she always seems a bit bashful when he comes up." "I think she really likes him, and I'm not sure what it is that makes her so shy around him. But I bet it's the same reason she's shy around people in general — she doesn't want to mess up, and she doesn't want to let people down, especially someone like McGraw who's so beloved in country music circles and who is a friend to her father."
